brief.en: Overnight, the brass lens vanished from the observatory telescope. Three people were awake, and one of their statements cannot be true.
brief.zh: 一夜之间，观星台望远镜上的黄铜镜片不见了。当晚有三个人醒着，其中一份证词不可能成立。

text.en: I spent the whole evening repairing the hall clock. I never climbed the tower.
text.zh: 整晚我都在大厅修钟，从没爬上过塔楼。

text.en: I carried tea up to the observatory at nine. The lens was still in the telescope.
text.zh: 九点我把茶送上观星台，那时镜片还在望远镜里。

text.en: I heard the tower door just after midnight, but I never left the library.
text.zh: 午夜刚过，我听见塔楼的门响了，但我一直没离开图书馆。

text.en: Fresh oil on the tower's stair rail: the same clove-scented oil used on the hall clock.
text.zh: 塔楼楼梯扶手上有新鲜的油渍，和大厅那座钟用的丁香味钟油一模一样。

text.en: A tea tray on the observatory desk, the pot long cold.
text.zh: 观星台桌上放着茶盘，茶壶早已凉透。

text.en: The tower's clockwork lock logged two openings: 21:02 and 00:10.
text.zh: 塔楼的发条锁记录了两次开启：21:02 和 00:10。

text.en: The library lamp burned its oil right down to dawn.
text.zh: 图书馆的油灯一直烧到了天亮。

solved.en: The clock oil puts the Clockmaker on the tower stairs, so “I never climbed the tower” cannot be true. That is a contradiction, not yet a culprit.
solved.zh: 钟表油说明钟表匠到过塔楼楼梯，所以“从没爬上过塔楼”不可能成立。这是一处矛盾，还不等于找到了犯人。

hint.en: Look for evidence that puts someone where they say they never went.
hint.zh: 找一找：哪条证据把某人放到了他声称没去过的地方？
